name: H3 Scene Studio
description: Native Gradio scene builder for MiniMax H3 Ref2VA. Russian UI, reference photo sets, randomized timed shots (intro/tease/HJ/BJ/breast/sex/cum), camera and sound control. Builds the English prompt and pushes it, with the attached photos, into the main generator. Includes scene library, story chains to the queue, and the benchmark-measured recipe (832x480 / 6 steps).
